figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Enzymatic synthesis of the C-2 O-methyl orsellinate thioester. a) Domain organization of orsellinate acid synthase (OAS) from fungi and
bacteria. Domains are abbreviated as follows: SAT, starter unit acyltransferase; KS, ketosynthase; MAT, malonyl acyltransferase; AT, acyltransferase;
PT, product template; ACP, acyl carrier protein; and TE, thioesterase. b) Experimental design of the in vitro orsellinate thioester biosynthesis
catalyzed by CalO5* and the O-methylation catalyzed by CalO6. Mutated residues are highlighted in red. c) Deconvoluted mass spectra of
TEV-cleaved ACP species from (i) apo-CalO5*, (ii) CalO5* incubated with Sfp, CoASH, and MgCl2, (iii) CalO5* incubated with Sfp, CoASH, MgCl2,
and malonyl-CoA, and (iv) CalO5* incubated with Sfp, CoASH, MgCl2, malonyl-CoA, CalO6, and SAM. d) The expected small molecules after P-Pant
ejection and the observed P-Pant ejection ions from intact-protein analysis of the cleaved ACP from (iii) and (iv).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. In vitro characterization of CalO3 as a FAD-dependent iodinase. a) UPLC-MS analysis of the acetonitrile (ACN) extract of denatured CalO3
conﬁrming it puriﬁes with FAD. The extracted ion chromatogram corresponds to [M + H]+ for FAD (m/z = 786.15 ± 0.02). b) Design of the
enzymatic reaction to characterize CalO3, including iodination reaction in the presence of the FAD reductase, FAD, NaI, and NADH, followed by TEV
cleavage for UPLC-MS analysis. c) Deconvoluted mass spectra of TEV protease-cleaved ACP species after CalO3 enzymatic reactions with diﬀerent
halides. The left ﬁgure shows the iodination reaction at various NaI concentrations: no NaI, 50 mM NaI, 50 µM NaI, 50 µM NaI with catalase, and
50 µM NaI using the CalO3 (K75A) mutant from top to bottom; the middle shows the bromination reaction at various NaBr concentrations: no NaBr,
50 mM NaBr, 50 µM NaBr, 50 µM NaBr with catalase, and 50 µM NaBr using the CalO3 (K75A) mutant from top to bottom; the right ﬁgure shows
the competition assays using no halide (top), 50 µM of NaI, NaBr, and NaCl, respectively (middle), and 50 µM NaI with 500 µM NaBr and 500 µM
NaCl, respectively (bottom). d) The expected small molecules after P-Pant ejection and the observed P-Pant ejection ions from intact-protein analysis
of the cleaved ACP from CalO3 catalyzed iodination reaction with 50 µM NaI (top), bromination reaction with 50 µM NaBr (middle), and 50 mM
NaBr (bottom).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Phylogenetic and structural analysis of FAD-dependent halogenases. a) Unrooted neighbor-joining tree of representative FAD-dependent
halogenases. Phylogenetic analysis was carried out in Clustal Omega[51] and visualized in iTOL v5.[52] b) A structural model of CalO3 with FAD ligand
predicted by AlphaFold 3. The catalytic Lys was highlighted in a red circle. c) Comparison of the predicted CalO3 structure modeled with FAD and
iodide using Chai-1[53] to the crystal structure of CndH (PDB:3e1t).[47] A224 in CalO3 was aligned with I221 in CndH within the signature residue
sequence (WxWxIP).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Enzymatic characterization of C-3 oxidation and O-methylation catalyzed by CalO2 and CalO1. a) Experimental design for characterization of
CalO2-catalyzed oxidation and analysis of the deconvoluted mass spectra of the control (with boiled CalO2) and the reaction (with CalO2 in the
presence of ferredoxin, ferredoxin reductase, and NADPH). Bottom right shows the expected small molecule after P-Pant ejection and the observed
P-Pant ejection ions from intact-protein analysis of the cleaved ACP after the CalO2 reaction. b) Experimental design for characterization of
CalO1-catalyzed C-3 O-methylation and analysis of the deconvoluted mass spectra of the control (with boiled CalO1) and the reaction (with CalO1 in
the presence of SAM). Bottom right shows the expected small molecule after P-Pant ejection and the observed P-Pant ejection ions from
intact-protein analysis of the cleaved ACP after the CalO1 reaction.
